Identity: oversized cream head, tiny body/feet, unequal green paddles and layered marked wing masses remain consistent across the three moth appearances. Occluded parts are not treated as missing anatomy.

Emotional contrast: open smiles and the raised workshop mallet sit alongside the closed-eye resting moth, supporting a warm range of activity without aging the mascot. This is an expert reading of cues.
